load_shortfall_analysis.bias_signature: shortfall power equivalent is a tight 1.03-3.09 kW band across all 192 records (median 1.66 kW) — the signature of a small systematic residual-monitor bias integrated over the voyage, not episodic genuine unserved load
load_shortfall_analysis.derate08_s: 0 in all 192 records — the propulsion derate never activated; a genuine sustained power shortage would have pulled the DC bus into the derate band
load_shortfall_analysis.episode_level: UNAVAILABLE — per-timestep trajectories were not persisted by the epoch-1 executor (design gap; see limitations)

evidence: field-name mismatch P_DG1_kW/P_DG2_kW (logged) vs P_gen1_kW/P_gen2_kW (expected by the checker) -> equal-split fallback
equal-split is provably wrong for PMS v2 unequal commitment/dispatch design
band_s is voyage-determined and arm-invariant in 28/48 voyages (mission low-load duration signature)

residual monitor semantics: the model builds P_bus_residual = P_gen*ASSUMED_eta_rect + P_bat_bus - P_load_total and documents it as the C*V*dV/dt capacitor-power consistency monitor — NOT an unserved-load indicator
ASSUMED_eta_rect=0.97 is marked INHERITED_LEGACY (hardcoded assumption); the genuine unserved-power signals (P_unserved_kW, P_gen_unserved_kW) exist in the model but are NOT used by the checker
tight 1.03-3.09 kW bias band across 192 records; derate08_s=0 everywhere (no genuine power starvation ever pulled the bus into derate)
zero-tolerance predicate (short_kWh==0) integrates the monitor bias into 1-3 kWh 'shortfall'
dSOC arm-invariant in 47/48 voyages to full float precision -> mission energy structure, not controller quality

all |dSOC| <= 0.0132; 96/144 marginal (0.005-0.01) — the +/-0.005 energy-neutrality contract (~5.4 kWh on the 1071 kWh battery) is stricter than what charge-sustaining operation achieves on these missions
